name: Manchester Cubing League - Final 2026
information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

Welcome to the first ever cubing league in Manchester! Top 16 finishers from each finals will be awarded points. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManchesterCLFinal2026#67570-manchester-cubing-league).

**Dual Rounds**
This competition will use Dual Rounds for 3x3, so everyone will have the opportunity to set at least 2 averages.
